title: 3DTCR: Vortex-following generative reconstruction improves tropical cyclone intensity prediction from global AI weather forecasts
abstract: arXiv:2603.13049v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Global numerical weather prediction (NWP) and artificial intelligence (AI) models often underestimate tropical cyclone (TC) intensity, partly because coarse grids underresolve fine-scale three-dimensional inner-core structures that influence TC intensity evolution. Kilometer-scale NWP simulations can better resolve these structures but are too costly for operational use, which also makes high-resolution TC data limited. Here we construct a 3-km, TC-centered dataset for 2018--2024 using the Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) model and develop 3DTCR, a vortex-following generative framework that reconstructs three-dimensional TC structure from FuXi global forecasts. 3DTCR combines conditional flow matching (CFM) with two-stage training to learn a coarse-to-fine mapping from center-aligned reanalysis simulation pairs and then adapt it to forecast inputs through latent space alignment. translated_title: 3DTCR：涡旋跟随生成式重建改进基于全球AI天气预报的热带气旋强度预测
translated_abstract: 全球数值天气预报（NWP）与人工智能（AI）模型往往低估热带气旋（TC）的强度，部分原因在于粗网格无法充分解析影响热带气旋强度演变的精细尺度三维内核结构。公里级NWP模拟能够更好地解析这些结构，但计算成本过高，难以用于业务运行，这也导致高分辨率热带气旋数据十分稀缺。本研究利用天气研究与预报模式（WRF）构建了2018-2024年以热带气旋为中心的3公里分辨率数据集，并开发了3DTCR——一种涡旋跟随的生成式框架，可从伏羲（FuXi）全球预报中重建热带气旋的三维结构。3DTCR将条件流匹配（CFM）与两阶段训练相结合，先从中心对齐的再分析-模拟配对数据中学习由粗到细的映射，再通过潜空间对齐将其适配到预报输入上。在2024年西北太平洋（WNP）上的评估显示……
tldr: 提出3DTCR框架，利用涡旋跟随的条件流匹配生成式重建方法，从全球AI天气预报中恢复热带气旋公里级三维内核结构，从而显著改进热带气旋强度预测。
en_tdlr: 3DTCR is a vortex-following generative framework based on conditional flow matching that reconstructs kilometer-scale 3D tropical cyclone structures from global AI weather forecasts, thereby improving tropical cyclone intensity prediction.
